changelog: Every large card view has a Show upgrade checkbox that puts the card and its upgrade side by side. A refugee you escort to safety now becomes a soldier of your choice: Bannerman, Rifleman or Rocket Soldier. The Chain of Command copy shows its 0 cost and One-Shot on the card. Overrun+ rewards only the unit it was played on. Hit & Run gives +2 move for every hit that unit landed this turn. Card text is rules only, no flavor. Menus all close from the same bottom button and fill the screen. A win that unlocks a new Ascension tier now says so.
